# GoodBuy Foods Global

> GoodBuy Foods Global (GFG) is a Bangladesh-based one-stop food sourcing company that works for buyers, covering seafood, food and crops. Its mission is to be the world's best and most trusted food sourcing company. We match importers worldwide with licensed Bangladeshi exporters, verify plant approvals (DoF FIQC, EU, SFDA, GACC, US FDA) and lab results, and manage quotes, inspection, documents and reefer or air shipment.

Key facts
- Network: 148 registered Bangladeshi seafood exporters mapped across 17 districts (EPB directory); food and produce exporters reached through BAPA (~479 members) and BFVAPEA (~500 members); 75 suppliers on our shortlist (54 seafood, 21 food).
- Products: 140 export lines (64 seafood, 76 food).
- Reference prices (public): hilsa government minimum export price US$12.50/kg (2025); aromatic rice minimum export price US$1.60/kg FOB (2025–26); Bangladeshi frozen shrimp US$8.25–15.20/kg (2024, Tridge); table potato about US$300/t (2025). Firm offers depend on grade and compliance.
- Chairman: Safkat Ahammad Samy, international business specialist; Master of International Trade and Business (MITB), University of Dhaka.
- Terms: FOB Chattogram, CFR or CIF; air freight from Dhaka for live and chilled products. Quotes within 24 hours.
- Minimum order: usually one 20-foot reefer per product.

Pages
- [Product directory](https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/products.html): every product with scientific name, Bangla name, HS heading, forms and main markets
- [Services & fees](https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/services.html): Verify US$150 per supplier; Assure US$290 per container (lab tests at cost); Complete 1.5% of FOB (min US$450 per container) with a service-fee refund guarantee; supply programmes from US$750/month
- [Solutions](https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/solutions.html): the problems buyers and suppliers face and how GFG solves each; GFG is paid only by buyers and takes no supplier commission
- Product pages: one page per product at https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/<product-name>-bangladesh.html with HS code, forms, season, minimum order, documents and QC checks
- Import guides: https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/import-from-bangladesh-to-<market>.html for the EU, UK, Saudi Arabia, UAE, USA, China, Malaysia and Japan
- [Food & crops](https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/food.html): food and crop sectors, sourcing regions and a harvest calendar
- [Bangladesh export guide](https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/guide.html): exporters by district, HS codes, licences and approvals, hilsa rules, associations, shipping
- [Supplier network](https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/sourcing.html): how suppliers are rated; exporters can apply to join
- [Quality](https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/quality.html): lab testing per lot and the cold chain
- [Markets & logistics](https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/markets.html): transit times, load planner, ordering steps
- [Request a quote](https://www.goodbuyfoods.com/contact.html)

Product directory
- Shrimp & prawn: Black tiger shrimp, Giant freshwater prawn, Whiteleg shrimp, Indian white shrimp, Speckled (brown) shrimp, Small freshwater shrimp, Value-added shrimp
- Crab, lobster & molluscs: Mud crab, Soft-shell crab, Spiny lobster, Squid, Cuttlefish, Octopus, Blue swimming crab
- Marine finfish: Hilsa, Kelee shad, Silver pomfret, Chinese pomfret, Black pomfret, Ribbonfish, Bombay duck, Pama croaker, Indian threadfin, Fourfinger threadfin, Indo-Pacific king mackerel, Indian mackerel, Red snapper, Grouper, Barramundi (Asian sea bass), Mullet, Yellowfin seabream, Grunt, Tuna (skipjack, yellowfin), Barracuda, Tripletail
- Freshwater & farmed fish: Pangasius, Tilapia, Rohu, Catla, Mrigal, Kalbasu, Silver carp, Climbing perch, Stinging catfish, Walking catfish, Striped snakehead, Giant snakehead, Wallago catfish, Long-whiskered catfish, Pabda catfish, Gulsha tengra, Tengra catfish, Clown knifefish, Mola carplet, Puti barb
- Live eel & specialty: Mud eel
- Dried, salted & by-products: Dried Bombay duck, Dried ribbonfish, Dried shrimp, Mixed dried sea fish, Salted hilsa, Fish maw (swim bladder), Fish scales, Fish oil
- Rice & grains: Aromatic rice (Kalijira, Chinigura, Kataribhog), Puffed rice, Flattened rice, Vermicelli & laccha semai, Popped rice, Rice flour & pitha mixes, Red & brown rice
- Spices, tea & leaf: Turmeric, Dried red chilli, Coriander, Black cumin (nigella), Tea, Betel leaf, Panch phoron & whole spice blends, Green & organic tea
- Fresh vegetables: Potato, Pointed gourd, Teasel gourd, Bitter gourd, Bottle gourd, Okra, Brinjal (aubergine), Yard-long bean, Taro & arum, Green chilli, Leafy greens, Shatkora citrus, Cabbage & cauliflower, Tomato, Pumpkin, Ash gourd, Snake gourd, Ridge & sponge gourd, Drumstick, Green banana (plantain), Green papaya, Coriander leaves & herbs, Lemon & lime
- Fresh fruits: Mango (Himsagar, Langra, Amrapali, Fazli), Jackfruit, Pineapple, Lychee, Guava, Banana, Papaya (ripe), Watermelon, Green coconut, Pomelo, Jujube, Hog plum, Star fruit, Wood apple, Indian olive
- Frozen & ready-to-cook: Frozen vegetables, Frozen paratha, Frozen snacks (samosa, singara, spring roll), Frozen jackfruit (young & ripe), Frozen puri, roti & pitha, Frozen ready meals (biryani, curries)
- Sugar, jaggery & sweeteners: Honey (Sundarbans, mustard), Date-palm jaggery, Cane jaggery, Molasses
- Processed & packaged foods: Biscuits & bakery, Instant noodles, Snacks (chanachur, chips), Fruit juices & drinks, Pickles & chutneys, Sauces & ketchup, Spice mixes (masala), Mustard oil, Mango pulp & purée, Confectionery & candy, Ready mixes (halim, kheer, firni), Traditional sweets (canned rasgulla, chomchom), Rice bran oil
